text: The in-lesson Checkpoints are the ones whose content is generated at random when the lesson loads in the browser, from current learned content, prior learned content, a taught piece and an untaught piece. The same Checkpoints are also available on Review & Practice. Corrects the scope in learning.checkpoint.untaught-piece-2026-10-05, which placed the mix on Review & Practice.
rationale: Owner clarified he means the in-lesson checkpoints
